values.note: ParkWith booking page, 1 night Tue 2027-06-15: every RV site (1-10) $75/night before ParkWith's 8% service fee and 10% tax.

fees.source: https://parkwith.us/camps/caseys-rv-park-and-campground (RV Site, Jun 15-16 2027, 30-amp: 'Site 1 20/30A 60ft Water $75.00 / night' ... 'Site 10 20/30/50A 60ft Water $75.00 / night'; page config service_rate 0.08, tax_rate 0.1), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.caseyscampground.com/about ('All of our RV sites are water and electric; our dump station near the entrance of our park so you can empty holding tanks as you leave') + https://parkwith.us/camps/caseys-rv-park-and-campground (sites 2-4 and 7-10 '20/30/50A', each 'Water'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: ParkWith lists RV sites 1-10: eight take 60 ft, sites 5 and 6 take 45 ft. Blackfeet-style tipis and tent sites besides.

sites.source: https://parkwith.us/camps/caseys-rv-park-and-campground (RV site list, Jun 15-16 2027: Site 1-10 with lengths 45-60 ft), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Showers included (7-minute timed, no coins). Small camp store (toiletries, firewood). Shuttle from the East Glacier train depot on request.

facilities.source: https://www.caseyscampground.com/about ('Showers are included in your stay ... 7 minute timed showers', 'our dump station near the entrance', 'high speed wifi that reaches out to the sites', 'a small camp store') + https://caseyscampground.com/ ('Newly built shower house and bathrooms'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://parkwith.us/camps/caseys-rv-park-and-campground (the booking page's camp settings: season_start_mm_dd '05-20', season_end_mm_dd '10-01'; the calendar opens at May 2027), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booked on the operator's ParkWith page (embedded at caseyscampground.com/reserve), one-night stays allowed; 'We book up quickly, especially on summer weekends'.

booking.source: https://www.caseyscampground.com/reserve (ParkWith embed; 'We book up quickly, especially on summer weekends') + https://parkwith.us/camps/caseys-rv-park-and-campground (minimum_bookable_nights 1), read 2026-10-22

note: Blackfeet-owned campground on five acres on US-2, 1 mile west of East Glacier Park (8 mi from Glacier's Two Medicine entrance); RV sites, Blackfeet-style tipis (bring your own bedding) and tents. --Claude
summary: Operator site + its ParkWith booking page: confirmed water at RV sites, showers, reservable online; added $75/night (June 2027 weeknight, before 8% service fee and tax), 50-amp, no sewer (dump station), 10 sites to 60 ft, dump/Wi-Fi/camp store, season May 20 - Oct 1 (booking-page setting). Phone 406-407-4597 confirmed (alt 406-450-0775). Note trimmed of restated values and the RV Life line.
